notes_for_editor: The 1932 build and 1960 destruction rest on one firelookout.com page; two WebSearch attempts did not corroborate them. Search results pointed to a different Square Mountain (an L-5 lookout, 1931, in the Nez Perce forest), so the Square Mountain reference needs a human check against the coordinates. No source read states public access, so no access fact is recorded; national forest ownership and the 2025 public hike do not establish it. The Wild Montana listing does not say whether the old lookout it passed is the 1932 cab site.
